Proposals.Development: The party successfully neutralized the goblin command structure by confronting Skrit Ironjaw, securing the exit route through a coordinated retreat, and returning to the village with the captives intact, thereby satisfying all resolution criteria for the Short arc.
Proposals.Evidence: The air outside was cold, sharp with the scent of rain-washed earth and pine. The sky was a bruised purple, the last light of the day fading into the encroaching night. Maren stepped over the threshold, her boots finding purchase on the wet stone, and for the first time in hours, she allowed herself to breathe. The keep was behind them. The village was ahead. And the story, for now, was finished.
Proposals.ProposedCurrentPhase: The rescue mission is complete; the party has returned to safety with the captives and the reward. The Short arc concludes as all earlier chapter targets (infiltration, confrontation, exit) are satisfied.
